section_summary: This section comprises consular and diplomatic records concerning the soybean and chemical industries in Manchuria and the Kwantung Leased Territory between 1932 and 1936. The primary item is an extensive October 1936 South Manchuria Railway Company report by Dr. Roy H. Akagi, transmitted by American Consul Stuart E. Grummon from Dairen, reviewing bean oil extraction technologies, byproduct cake utilization, plant construction costs, and trade statistics. The section also includes a December 1932 State Department Division of Far Eastern Affairs memorandum regarding ammonium sulphate manufacturing in Dairen.

subfiles.about: Covering despatch transmitting a South Manchuria Railway Company publication on the bean oil industry in Manchuria.
subfiles.summary: American Consul Stuart E. Grummon transmits a South Manchuria Railway Company pamphlet analyzing Manchurian bean oil extraction methods and costs.
subfiles.title: Transmission of Pamphlet on Bean Oil Industry in Manchuria

subfiles.about: A comprehensive report on Manchurian bean oil extraction methods, bean cake varieties, soybean utilization, mill construction expenses, and export statistics.
subfiles.from: Dr. Roy H. Akagi, South Manchuria Railway Company
subfiles.summary: This South Manchuria Railway report provides a comprehensive study of the soybean and bean oil industry in Manchuria. It details and compares various oil extraction methods—including wedge, screw, hydraulic, benzine, and alcohol abstraction systems—and examines varieties of bean cake and diverse commercial soybean products. The work also provides detailed construction costs for typical Dairen oil mills alongside export statistics and crop output data from 1924 through 1935.
subfiles.title: Bean Oil Industry in Manchuria

subfiles.about: Internal memorandum concerning ammonium sulphate production capacity in Dairen and its potential market orientation.
subfiles.summary: Notes a Dairen plant producing ammonium sulphate aimed primarily at foreign markets due to lacking Manchurian demand.
subfiles.title: Memorandum on Ammonium Sulphate Production in Dairen
